input_fields.name: body_reference
input_fields.description: One current body reference whose edges are to be enumerated.

result_fields.name: edge_collection
result_fields.description: All current edges owned by body_reference.

result_fields.name: body_binding
result_fields.description: Body identity and ownership check proving no other body was mixed in.

procedure: Resolve body_reference and verify the current body ownership.
Read the body's current edge collection once and preserve edge identities.
Check ownership for every returned edge and report body_binding.
Do not select an edge loop, measure edge lengths, or repair topology here.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous/stale body references or mixed-body edge collections.
Reject pre-mutation edge handles after topology changed.
Do not infer edge-loop membership from enumeration alone.
